title.narrative: USAID/Malawi’s Organized Network of Services for Everyone’s Health (ONSE) activity

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Organized Network of Services for Everyone's Health's (ONSE) activity focuses on maternal, neonatal, and child health; voluntary family planning; malaria; water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH); and nutrition. ONSE will continue to: 1) scale up effective, equitable, locally adapted, and evidence-based interventions to reach poor, marginalized, and vulnerable people, including youth and adolescents; 2) advance quality of priority health services; 3) address gender-based violence through community sensitization and awareness, one stop centres, and enhanced service for victims; and, 4) support sustainable access to WASH services and products. WASH services include supporting community and health facility driven efforts; championing the adoption of positive hygienic behaviours; and providing WASH governance bodies with skills-based training to improve the sustainable management of WASH services. Community mobilization efforts include social and behavior change communication on voluntary family planning, gender norms, timely care seeking, and healthy household practices and behaviors. ..The activity aligns with the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and are able to contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work...
